CertAuthority._devNote: Defaults below are relative paths; PlexorCaBootstrap rewrites them to <repo>/dev-certs/... at first boot. Production overrides the entire section via env vars (CertAuthority__CertPath, CertAuthority__KeyPath, CertAuthority__HostCertPath, CertAuthority__HostKeyPath) or appsettings.Production.json. Example Linux deploy at /var/lib/plexor/ — see dev-certs/README.md.

Audit._devNote: Retention sweep knobs (Phase 5.3). Defaults keep 90 days, sweep once per day at 05:00 UTC, batch up to 10_000 rows per transaction. Production overrides via env vars (Audit__RetentionDays, Audit__CleanupInterval, Audit__BatchSize, Audit__SweepHourUtc) or appsettings.Production.json.
